# rmt-foundations 0.2.0

> Lean 4 library (package `RMTFoundations`) of Tracy–Widom, Airy, Painlevé II,
> finite GUE and analytic random-matrix results. Proved: TW1/TW2 distribution
> functions, measures, smooth densities, quantiles, moments and tail bounds;
> Hastings–McLeod; TW4 function identities; extended Airy kernel with its
> one-time TW2 reduction. Not established: TW4 monotonicity or TW4 measure;
> GUE edge limit without the hypothesis `GUELimit TW2R`; unconditional multi-time Airy2
> convergence; conditional limit laws retain explicit producer hypotheses; sharp cubic left-tail asymptotics;
> a sign certificate covering the compact gap between the two proved TW4 tails.

Declarations and their hypotheses outrank all prose, including this file.
Links point to branch `main`; for release `v0.2.0`, read the same paths at
that tag.
